details: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East have significantly escalated, leading to a sharp rise in oil prices. Saudi Arabia temporarily shut down its East-West oil pipeline on September 11, 2026, following drone attacks attributed to Iranian-backed militias in Iraq. This pipeline is critical for bypassing the Strait of Hormuz, a vital global oil transit route. Further exacerbating concerns, a merchant vessel was reportedly struck in the Strait of Hormuz on September 13, resulting in casualties. Simultaneously, a scheduled meeting in Oman for September 14 between Iran and Gulf states to discuss the Strait of Hormuz was postponed, with Saudi Arabia reportedly requesting the delay.
title: Middle East Tensions Escalate: Oil Surges, Hormuz Talks Postponed

details: The US Senate Republicans released the final text of the CLARITY Act, a significant crypto market structure bill, on September 14, 2026. This move comes ahead of a crucial cloture vote and incorporates updated ethics provisions and enforcement changes, reportedly with the agreement of President Donald Trump. The bill aims to provide clearer regulatory guidelines for the digital asset space.
title: US Senate Advances CLARITY Act for Crypto Regulation
